parameters.description: Address of PACTRL_ACCESSW pointer variable that receives a pointer to the access list structure. May not be NULL. If the call succeeds, the caller must free the allocated memory with the CoTaskMemFree function. Note that the memory is allocated (all_nodes), which means that all the substructures are allocated in one block. Therefore, the entire data structure must be freed by a single call to CoTaskMemFree .
